capabilities: Receive obsidian://zotero-note links carrying a citekey
Run a Zotero Integration import for that citekey
Open the imported Markdown note in a new tab
Accept a format query parameter to pick the import format
extras: Needs a Zotero Integration import format named Paper Note (or a format= URL parameter) and matching vault/folder settings; relies on Zotero Integration's runImport(), which the README notes is not a formally stable public API. Part of the paired Zotero Obsidian Bridge, with a Chinese README.
intentEvidence: Citekey Import Bridge calls Zotero Integration's runImport() method.
problem: Getting from a Zotero item to its literature note in Obsidian otherwise means copying the citekey and starting the Zotero Integration import by hand.

relations.evidence: The Obsidian plugin receives the citekey and calls Zotero Integration's runImport(format, citekey, library).
Better BibTeX for Zotero, unless your Zotero version exposes a native citationKey field.

summary: Obsidian desktop plugin that receives obsidian://zotero-note citekey links, runs a Zotero Integration import, and opens the resulting note.
